name: Chota Aadmi Gundai Karna Chahta Hai
visual_description: Manoj Bajpayee as Sardar Khan in Gangs of Wasseypur looking casually dismissive inside an auto-rickshaw with the subtitle 'Chota Aadmi Gundai Karna Chahta Hai Karne Do'.
usage_context: Used sarcastically to indulge, patronize, or mock someone inexperienced or weak trying to act tough, ambitious, or rebellious.

example.caption: When your younger brother tries to argue with you after watching one sigma male reel
